translations.web: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.
translations.bsb: At the top of each stand was a circular band half a cubit high. The supports and panels were cast as a unit with the top of the stand.
translations.kjv: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
translations.asv: And in the top of the base was there a round compass half a cubit high; and on the top of the base the stays thereof and the panels thereof were of the same.
